controlRepair.reason: The combined watcher scans Python-curated admissions but its post-combine dedupe consulted only the legacy JavaScript release manifest. Already-admitted Python blog sources could therefore reach the issue publisher as false material candidates.
controlRepair.repair: Filter combined watch candidates against both the generated JavaScript manifest and the full Python catalog emitted by `python3 -m szl_frontier list --min-score 70`; accept either catalog shape deterministically and fail closed on malformed admission input.
tests: Python-curated admitted blog candidates are suppressed before alert publication
existing model and dataset normalized-artifact churn rules remain unchanged
